parameters.name: InstanceId
parameters.description: The ID of the FeatureStore instance. Call the ListInstances operation to get the instance ID.

parameters.name: Name
parameters.description: The name of the data source.

parameters.name: Order
parameters.description:
The sort order. Valid values:

- Asc: ascending order.

- Desc: descending order.

parameters.name: PageNumber
parameters.description: The page number. Pages start from 1. Default value: 1.

parameters.name: PageSize
parameters.description: The number of data sources per page. Default value: 10.

parameters.name: Type
parameters.description:
The type of the data source. Valid values:

- Hologres

- Redis

- MaxCompute

parameters.name: WorkspaceId
parameters.description: The ID of the workspace. Call the [ListWorkspaces](~~449124~~) operation to get the workspace ID.
